Nov 25: Christian Watson (concussion) was ruled out just before halftime after a hit from Kam Kinchens, who was ejected. Watson had already scored 16.5 for Wild Goose Chase on four catches, 65 yards and a touchdown.

Nov 25: Josh Jacobs (finger) missed his second straight game, so the Breece'sBurdenDeflowered bench didn't cost rtmcruise anything there. Tyler Higbee left with a chest injury and Davis Allen with an ankle injury.
Nov 26: Kenneth Walker III (groin) is out for Kansas City at Buffalo tonight. He's on the Lead Nagger bench, so Pudge247 isn't burned.

Nov 26: Dallas TE Jake Ferguson (knee) and WR Jonathan Mingo (ankle) are out against Philadelphia; Jalen Hurts remains on IR for the Eagles. Dallas Goedert starts for Stroud of Turin and Saquon Barkley for MY DAD IS DEAD.
Nov 26: Dalton Kincaid (thumb) is questionable for Buffalo tonight and is in the Ivefallenandicantgetup lineup, with Hunter Henry, added Wednesday, on the bench.

Nov 25: Wednesday's free-agent run: RedDevil904 swapped Aaron Rodgers for Sam Darnold, FatMikeR swapped Austin Ekeler for Mack Hollins, Pudge247 added Ted Hurst III, and ChuckJ10 dropped Mark Andrews.

stories.title: Blake Corum runs 32 times for 184 yards and hands Achane in the Membrane a 33.40-point head start
stories.dek: Wednesday night is final: Rams 26, Packers 13. Corum's 28.5 is the best score of the night, Kyren Williams puts NjigbaR Please! up 16.50 in the first-place game, and Christian Watson leaves with a concussion after 16.5 for Wild Goose Chase.
body: Week 12 started on Thanksgiving Eve and Blake Corum treated it like a workout he was paid by the rep for. Thirty-two carries, 184 yards, a touchdown and two catches for 21 more, good for 28.5 points in the Achane in the Membrane lineup. Add Matthew Golden's 4.9 and MakeItRains leads Stroud of Turin 33.40 to 0.00 in a game where Achane in the Membrane was a 1.5-point dog. That's the same team that lost by 0.06 last week, so obviously the universe owes it one. The head start bumps its playoff odds from 7% to 9%, which in fairness is still 91% bad.

In the first-place game, Kyren Williams scored the Rams' first touchdown and caught four balls for 16.5, so NjigbaR Please! leads Ivefallenandicantgetup 16.50 to 0.00. krunkdd answers tonight with Josh Allen, James Cook III and Dalton Kincaid (thumb, questionable) against Kansas City. Matthew Stafford only threw for 140 yards in a game the Rams ran 47 times, which is why Breece'sBurdenDeflowered leads Llamageddon by a whole 3.60. Josh Jacobs (finger) missed his second straight game and was on the rtmcruise bench, so no harm there.

Wild Goose Chase got its Packers back from the bye and leads MY DAD IS DEAD 28.52 to 0.00: Christian Watson caught four passes for 65 yards and a touchdown for 16.5 before he was ruled out with a concussion shortly before halftime, Jordan Love threw two picks for 8.62, and Tucker Kraft caught three balls for 3.4. Three catches is the most by any starting tight end in the league so far, which matters because this is the tight end receptions payout week.

On my end, Konata Mumpfield caught four passes for 69 yards and 10.9 points on the Lawrence of a Labia bench. Of course he did. Thanksgiving brings Bears at Lions, Eagles at Cowboys and Chiefs at Bills, and Kenneth Walker III (groin) is out tonight, sitting harmlessly on the Lead Nagger bench, while I have Jameson Williams, DeVonta Smith and DJ Moore going today against a 14.5-point line. Happy Thanksgiving. Start the right guys.

stories.title: The simulator after Wednesday night: Stroud of Turin and Wild Goose Chase swap the last two spots, Lead Nagger still the favorite
stories.dek: Three 8-3 teams, two byes, and the 6-5 logjam with Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 38% to crash it.
body: Same 20,000-season simulator, now with the real Wednesday-night points baked into Week 12. Ivefallenandicantgetup (9.8 projected wins, 99%) and NjigbaR Please! (9.8, 100%) are the projected byes, separated by points; whoever wins their head-to-head this week takes the inside track. Lawrence of a Labia projects third (9.2 wins, 96%) and Lead Nagger fourth (9.0, 98%).

The last two spots flipped this morning: Stroud of Turin is the projected 5 seed (7.7 wins, 76%) and Wild Goose Chase the 6 (7.6, 69%). Wild Goose Chase leads by 28.52 already, but it plays Lead Nagger and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered the next two weeks, while Christian Watson now has a concussion. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered is the first team out at 38%, then Llamageddon (9%), Achane in the Membrane (9%, up from 7% thanks to Blake Corum) and Bijan is your daddy (6%).

The projected bracket: Lead Nagger over Stroud of Turin (57%) and Wild Goose Chase over Lawrence of a Labia (58%) in the wild card round, Lead Nagger over Ivefallenandicantgetup (66%) and Wild Goose Chase over NjigbaR Please! (53%) in the semis, and Lead Nagger over Wild Goose Chase (59%) for the Aniston. Title odds from the full simulation: Lead Nagger 31%, NjigbaR Please! 19%, Stroud of Turin 13%, Ivefallenandicantgetup 13%, Wild Goose Chase 10%, Lawrence of a Labia 10%. Yes, my team is the favorite to lose in the first round. I've seen it before.

stories.title: Achane in the Membrane loses by six hundredths, Bijan is your daddy comes back from 38 down on Monday night, and Llamageddon's 58.52 makes the Hall of Fame
stories.dek: Three Commanders erase a 38.18-point deficit, Mike Gesicki falls 0.06 short, Ja'Marr Chase falls 9.95 short, and there are now three 8-3 teams.
body: Monday night decided three games and made two people sick. Bijan is your daddy went into Monday down 101.26 to 63.08 to Ivefallenandicantgetup, and Jayden Daniels (17.06), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (15.7, a touchdown in his first game off IR) and Stefon Diggs (8.5) scored 41.26 to win 104.34 to 101.26. krunkdd had nobody left to play, Derrick Henry (19.1) and Justice Hill (17.6) on the bench, and a best possible lineup of 112.46 that wins. The Tampa Bay defense, a $12 claim, scored 0.0.

Achane in the Membrane went into Monday down 4.16 to Breece'sBurdenDeflowered, with Mike Gesicki against Chase Brown. Gesicki caught 5 passes for 77 yards, 12.7 points. Chase Brown scored 8.6. Final: Breece'sBurdenDeflowered 128.22, Achane in the Membrane 128.16. Six hundredths. Devaughn Vele scored 14.6 on MakeItRains's bench while Adonai Mitchell started and scored 5.0, and the best possible lineup was 137.86. It's the fourth-highest score of the week and Achane in the Membrane is 4-7 with a 68-53 all-play record.

Stroud of Turin needed 18.05 from Ja'Marr Chase and got 8.1, so NjigbaR Please! won 116.50 to 106.56 behind Ashton Jeanty (28.9) and Travis Kelce (25.4). Lead Nagger beat Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52, a 79.28-point margin and the biggest of the week. Llamageddon's 58.52 is the lowest score in the league this season and the fifth-lowest in league history, which bumps RedDevil904's 58.64 out of the Hall of Fame's basement. Lawrence of a Labia scored 143.22, the high of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD (124.70, with Dak Prescott at 35.9) by 18.52, with Fernando Mendoza's 23.88 on my own bench behind Trevor Lawrence's 12.74. Wild Goose Chase beat Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 while Antonio Williams scored 21.2 on ChuckJ10's bench.

Where that leaves us: NjigbaR Please!, Ivefallenandicantgetup and Lawrence of a Labia are all 8-3, Lead Nagger is 7-4, and Stroud of Turin, Wild Goose Chase and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered are 6-5 fighting over two spots. Three weeks left. MakeItRains won the Week 11 defense payout with the Chicago Bears (17.0), which is the most expensive consolation prize in league history.

feature.title: Week 11: six hundredths, a 38-point Monday night comeback, and 58.52
body: The league averaged 112.37 in Week 11, and three games were decided on Monday night by players from one 22-20 game in Landover. Bijan is your daddy trailed Ivefallenandicantgetup 101.26 to 63.08 going into the night and won 104.34 to 101.26 behind Jayden Daniels (17.06), Jacory Croskey-Merritt (15.7) and Stefon Diggs (8.5). FatMikeR picked up Croskey-Merritt on Nov 18 off IR and he scored a touchdown in his first game back. krunkdd's best possible lineup was 112.46, with Derrick Henry (19.1) and Justice Hill (17.6) on the bench, and Bhayshul Tuten (8.3) left hurt in the fourth quarter.

Achane in the Membrane and Breece'sBurdenDeflowered played to 128.16 and 128.22. Breece'sBurdenDeflowered led by 4.16 going into Monday; Mike Gesicki gave MakeItRains 12.7 and Chase Brown gave rtmcruise 8.6, and the difference is the six hundredths. Cam Ward scored 23.22 and Mike Evans 22.9 for the winners. MakeItRains started Adonai Mitchell (5.0) over Devaughn Vele (14.6), and the best possible lineup (137.86) wins by almost ten. It's the closest game in the league this year.

Stroud of Turin needed 18.05 from Ja'Marr Chase and got 8.1 on 5 catches for 31 yards, so NjigbaR Please! won 116.50 to 106.56. RedDevil904 also left Aaron Rodgers (15.98) on the bench behind C.J. Stroud (21.46), which was the right call, and Pat Freiermuth (9.0) on the bench behind Dallas Goedert (4.8), which wasn't. Lead Nagger hammered Llamageddon 137.80 to 58.52 behind Jonah Coleman (34.9) and Emmett Johnson (24.3), and dcrabb's 58.52 is the fifth-lowest score in league history.

Lawrence of a Labia scored 143.22, the best of the week, and beat MY DAD IS DEAD by 18.52 to cover the 16.5-point line. I started Trevor Lawrence (12.74) over Fernando Mendoza (23.88), and I'd like that one back. Wild Goose Chase covered against Nothing to see here 108.16 to 90.94 with Tyjae Spears at 0.0 in the FLEX, and ChuckJ10's best lineup (123.34) wins that game too, with Antonio Williams (21.2) on the bench. Week 11's defense payout goes to MakeItRains for the Chicago Bears' 17.0.

columns.title: Barry "The Mouth" McCockiner: Pudge247 CUT TWO GUYS AT 6:41 IN THE MORNING and nobody is asking WHY
columns.dek: The best team in the league just emptied two roster spots before the commish game. I have questions. I have SO many questions.
body: I got to the press box at five this morning because the coffee machine is free before six, and I'm sitting there refreshing the transaction log like a normal person, and at 6:41 AM, BOOM. Emari Demercado, dropped. Twelve seconds later, BOOM. Tank Dell, dropped. No adds. Nothing. Pudge247 just walked into the kitchen, threw two plates in the trash and walked out.

Let me give you the numbers because NOBODY ELSE WILL. Lead Nagger scores 133.59 a week. That is the best in the league. The all-play record is 80-41. That is ALSO the best in the league. This team won Week 11 by 79.28. And the man running it wakes up on the Wednesday of a short week and decides the roster is TOO FULL? Tank Dell has 36.8 PPR points in four games. That's 9.2 a game, and you're telling me that's not worth a bench spot on a team with Walker hurt and Addison hurt? Come ON.

And the opponent this week is the COMMISH. Lawrence of a Labia, 8-3, 143.22 last week. Lead Nagger is a 14.5-point favorite, 68%, and Kenneth Walker III (groin) is questionable and Jordan Addison (thumb) is doubtful. So you've got a hurt running back, a hurt receiver and two empty spots. Either Pudge247 knows something, or Pudge247 is about to win this league with thirteen guys, and honestly, I don't know which one scares me more.

I'm HEARING things, and you are not going to like them. Word in the press box is Pudge247 cleared those spots because he's planning to claim two kickers, in a league that does not have a kicker slot, "for the vibes." I'm told he has a third spot picked out for a punter he's never seen play. None of this is confirmed, and the guy who told me also told me the coffee machine was free after six, which it is NOT.

Here's where I land. Lead Nagger is the title favorite at 31% in the Climax Bracket, and I'm not moving off that. But if those two spots are still EMPTY when Walker's status comes down Thursday, I am going to stand on this desk and SCREAM. Fill your roster, Pudge247. FILL. YOUR. ROSTER.

columns.title: Dick Fitzwell: Blake Corum ran 32 times and Stroud of Turin is down 33 before the turkey. Soft.
columns.dek: Thirty-two carries is a man's workload. Watching Achane in the Membrane get it on the waiver-wire side of the room is the soft part.
body: Put the tape on. Rams-Packers, Wednesday night. The Rams ran it 47 times. Blake Corum took 32 of them for 184 yards and a touchdown, 25 carries for 161 in the second half alone. That's not a running back, that's a man pushing a sled up a hill for three hours. He caught two more for 21. That's 28.5 points in the Achane in the Membrane lineup, and that's a 33.40-to-0.00 lead on Stroud of Turin before anybody's carved a bird.

Now the soft part. Stroud of Turin was a 1.5-point favorite in this game. RedDevil904 spent Wednesday morning cutting Aaron Rodgers to pick up Sam Darnold, a backup quarterback move on a team starting C.J. Stroud. That's housekeeping. Meanwhile the other guy's running back was getting fitted for an ice bath. You want to win a fantasy matchup, you go get the guy who gets the ball 32 times. Simple.

And Green Bay. Christian Watson caught four for 65 and a touchdown, 16.5 for Wild Goose Chase, then took a shot from Kam Kinchens before halftime and was out with a concussion. Kinchens got tossed. After that the Packers ran 16 plays in the second half. Jordan Love threw two picks for 8.62. That's a quarterback getting bullied. Br0phy still leads MY DAD IS DEAD 28.52 to nothing because MY DAD IS DEAD hasn't played, not because anybody in green was tough.

I'm HEARING things from the film room, and I want to be clear none of this is confirmed. Word is MakeItRains watched Corum's second half standing up, in pads, in his living room, and tried to set his Week 13 lineup by yelling it at the TV. Sources say he's now proposing a league rule that any running back with 30 carries counts double. None of this is confirmed. All of it should be.

Bottom line. Achane in the Membrane is 4-7 and still a long shot at 9%. But that's a team that went out and got hit in the mouth by six hundredths last week and came back and ran the ball 32 times. Stroud of Turin, you've got Amon-Ra St. Brown and Dallas Goedert today. Hit somebody.

columns.title: Oliver Klozoff's five things to do during Thanksgiving dinner that will definitely win your matchup
columns.dek: I'm writing this from a lawn chair in the driveway because that's where the good ideas are. Results not guaranteed. Results not even likely.
body: Wednesday night is final, Rams 26, Packers 13, and my lawn chair is already facing the right direction for Detroit. Here's what you do with the rest of the holiday, in order of importance.

1. Bench every Packer. Jordan Love threw two picks for 8.62, Tucker Kraft caught three balls for 3.4, so the logic is simple: Green Bay doesn't play again until December 6, which means a benched Packer can't hurt you. Yes, Br0phy already played his and is winning 28.52 to 0.00. That's what you call a fluke.

2. Start the guy on your bench who just scored. Konata Mumpfield scored 10.9 on the Lawrence of a Labia bench Wednesday night. Bill_Buttlicker should immediately move him into the lineup. I've been told this doesn't work after the game has been played. I have been told a lot of things.

3. Trust the spread, but backwards. Wild Goose Chase is a 23.5-point favorite with a 78% win chance over MY DAD IS DEAD. Seventy-eight is a big number, and big numbers are scary. So take MY DAD IS DEAD, who is 1-10. The math checks out if you don't do it.

4. Draft a running back at the dinner table. Blake Corum ran 32 times for 184 yards. Whoever at your table has eaten the most rolls is the closest thing to Corum you have access to. Put him in your FLEX. Your commish will have questions.

5. I'm told, and I want to stress that none of this is confirmed, that one manager in this league plans to make his waiver claims for next week by drawing names out of a gravy boat. Sources say the gravy boat has already been more accurate than FatMikeR's FAAB plan, which is still $200 untouched. Not confirmed. Can't be ruled out. Pass the stuffing.

columns.title: Connie Lingus: NjigbaR Please! is 3.90 points better per game, which means first place will be decided at 2:17 PM on Sunday
columns.dek: I ran the numbers on the first-place game. The numbers ran back, and they had a lot to say.
body: Let's start with what's real. NjigbaR Please! scores 123.28 a week, Ivefallenandicantgetup scores 119.38. That's a gap of 3.90, and it's why the line is 3.5 with a 54% win chance. All-play is 73-48 against 64-57. Both teams are 8-3, and NjigbaR Please! leads on points, 1,356.08 to 1,313.16.

Now let's do analytics. A game lasts 60 minutes, so 3.90 points per game is 0.065 points per minute. Over the four NFL windows that matter Sunday, that compounds, and by my math the first-place game flips to NjigbaR Please! at exactly 2:17 PM Eastern. I didn't account for the Wednesday game, but Kyren Williams is a full participant, so I'm calling that a positive 0.065.

The all-play gap is nine wins, 73 to 64. Nine is three times three, and there are three weeks left in the regular season. Which means each week is worth exactly three all-play wins to dstafford4254, a number I find very comforting and will not be explaining further.

Then there's the Ivefallenandicantgetup bench. Derrick Henry cleared his concussion evaluation, and as of this morning he and Justice Hill are on the bench, with Bhayshul Tuten (questionable) starting. Last week Henry scored 19.1 on that bench in a 3.08-point loss. My model says the expected value of starting Henry is positive. My second model says the expected value of listening to my first model is also positive. Both models are me.

Sources say krunkdd has asked Sleeper whether Henry and Hill can share one RB slot "like a timeshare condo," with each one counting for half. I'm told the request came with a spreadsheet that just says "BALTIMORE" in every cell. None of this is confirmed, and Sleeper does not do timeshares.
Final number: 54%. That's the line, that's the model, and that's the most honest thing I've written all week. NjigbaR Please! by 3.5.

commish.title: Contacts for Your Mom
commish.dek: The two men who run this league, collect your money, and answer to no one.

body: The winningest manager in Addicks history, the man who built this website, and somehow still without a ring. Bill_Buttlicker has 65 regular-season wins, six playoff trips in seven years, and a 2019 final he'd rather not talk about.
He runs the league, sets the payouts, and writes the newsletter that roasts all of you. He also scored 214.54 in 2019 Week 5, the second-highest week in league history. Respect the office.

The first champion in Addicks history. ChuckJ10 won it all in 2019, made the final again in 2021, and went 11-3 as last year's top seed. He has the ring the commissioner doesn't, and he's the second-winningest manager of all time.
This season has been a different story, and the co-commish has been on the receiving end of more than a few A.N.A.L. headlines. Fortunately, he has the authority to overturn none of them.

items.label: Matchup of the Week
items.title: NjigbaR Please! vs. Ivefallenandicantgetup: two 8-3 teams play for the 1 seed
items.dek: First place, the projected 1 and 2 seeds, and two banged-up running backs.
body: On paper this is the game of the week. NjigbaR Please! and Ivefallenandicantgetup are both 8-3, first and second on the projected seed list, and the winner leads the league with two weeks left. NjigbaR Please! scores 123.28 a week with a 73-48 all-play record; Ivefallenandicantgetup scores 119.38 with a 64-57 all-play record. One team has been good; the other has been good at Sundays.

The gap is 3.90, so the line is NjigbaR Please! by 3.5, a 54% favorite, with a 242.7 total. No nudge: there are no byes, Kyren Williams is a full participant on the Rams' report, and Derrick Henry cleared his concussion evaluation, with Justice Hill behind him on the same roster.

Wednesday night went to NjigbaR Please!: Kyren Williams scored 16.5 with a rushing touchdown and four catches in the Rams' 26-13 win, so the lead is 16.50 to 0.00. Ivefallenandicantgetup gets Josh Allen, James Cook III and Dalton Kincaid (thumb, questionable) tonight against Kansas City, plus Javonte Williams against the Eagles, and Derrick Henry is back in the starting lineup on Sunday with a questionable tag. A 16.5-point head start is more than four times the line, so the take holds: NjigbaR Please! by 3.5.

items.label: Shit Show of the Week
items.title: Bijan is your daddy vs. Nothing to see here: the lowest total of the week
items.dek: A 5-6 team with 5% playoff odds against a 2-9 team on a seven-game losing streak.
body: This is the ugliest game on the board. Bijan is your daddy is 5-6 and scores 112.18 a week with a 50-71 all-play record. Nothing to see here is 2-9, scores 103.95 a week, is 40-81 in all-play and has lost seven straight. The total is 216.1, the lowest of the week by 12 points.

The gap is 8.23, so the line is Bijan is your daddy by 8.5, a 61% favorite. No nudge. Trey McBride has 87 catches, the most of any tight end in the league, going into the tight end receptions payout week. Woody Marks (concussion) is questionable per Sleeper for Nothing to see here.

Nothing has been played. Nothing to see here gets Caleb Williams and Makai Lemon on Thanksgiving, and Bijan is your daddy gets Sam LaPorta in Detroit and Khalil Shakir in Buffalo, with Stefon Diggs (questionable per Sleeper) starting on Sunday. FatMikeR swapped Austin Ekeler for Mack Hollins on Wednesday and ChuckJ10 cut Mark Andrews, which is about as much excitement as this game has generated. The take stays Bijan is your daddy by 8.5.

items.label: Blowie of the Week
items.title: Wild Goose Chase vs. MY DAD IS DEAD: the biggest spread of the week
items.dek: The projected 5 seed gets its Packers back from the bye against a 1-10 team.
body: The biggest spread of Week 12. Wild Goose Chase is 6-5, scores 125.79 a week, is 67-54 in all-play and is the projected 6 seed at 69% this morning. MY DAD IS DEAD is 1-10, scores 102.31 a week and has lost nine straight, though it did score 124.70 last week.

The gap is 23.48, so the line is Wild Goose Chase by 23.5, a 78% favorite, with a 228.1 total. No nudge. Br0phy gets Jordan Love, Christian Watson and Tucker Kraft back from the bye, and Drake Maye (ankle) is still out. Saquon Barkley is a full participant on Philadelphia's report ahead of Thanksgiving for MY DAD IS DEAD.

Wednesday night was a 28.52-to-0.00 head start for Wild Goose Chase: Christian Watson 16.5 on four catches and a touchdown, Jordan Love 8.62 and Tucker Kraft 3.4. Watson left with a concussion before halftime, but his points count. MY DAD IS DEAD plays Saquon Barkley, Dak Prescott, Josh Downs and Rome Odunze today, so this is the day it has to happen. It won't. Wild Goose Chase by 23.5.
